rules.description: Use the Bakery semantic export instead of generated primitives or feature-local replacements.
Contain content within shared responsive structures without document-level overflow.
Preserve native roles, accessible names, focus visibility, and keyboard operation.
Render translated message keys and logical layout rather than embedded product copy.
Use native button or link semantics that match action versus navigation intent.
Keep authorization and mutation orchestration outside presentational UI modules.
Replace nonessential motion with an instant state change when reduced motion is requested.
Annotate deliberate scrolling or truncation and reject accidental overflow.

requirements.description: Preserve semantic roles and readable contrast in both authored light and dark themes.
Reflow without accidental overflow at sheet, pane, rail, and 200 percent zoom contexts.
Treat coarse and fine pointer capability independently from viewport width and preserve usable targets.
Expose correct role, name, state, keyboard order, focus visibility, and focus return.
Use translated message keys, logical properties, direction handling, and copy expansion.

Governing semantic component responsibilities and shared interface rules.

Approved synthetic list; paired dark and phone source frames retained.
Settings area composition, appearance, access and recovery states for the O-0 frames.
